# spec: Front Bumper (dry-run test product written by the team, not an organizer case)

## Product Type

Front bumper assembly — exterior front-end module of a passenger car, combining the bumper fascia, energy absorber,
reinforcement beam, integrated lamps and driver-assistance sensors.

## Vehicle Category

M1 — passenger car.

## Function

- Low-speed impact protection of the vehicle front end
- Pedestrian protection (lower leg impact zone)
- Front fog lamp integration
- Front direction indicator integration (side corners)
- Parking distance sensing (ultrasonic sensors)
- Front radar sensor mounting behind the emblem (adaptive cruise / emergency braking)
- Front registration plate mounting

## Main Parts

- Bumper fascia (painted)
- Energy absorber
- Reinforcement beam with crash boxes
- Lower grille and air intake
- Front fog lamps (LED) with bezels
- Front direction indicator lamps (LED)
- Ultrasonic parking sensors (4) with wiring harness
- Radar sensor bracket and radome emblem
- Registration plate holder
- Towing eye cover

## Materials

Representative values — confirm against actual bill of materials.

| Component             | Typical material(s)              |
| --------------------- | -------------------------------- |
| Bumper fascia         | PP/EPDM-TD20, painted            |
| Energy absorber       | EPP foam                         |
| Reinforcement beam    | Aluminium extrusion              |
| Lower grille          | PC/ABS                           |
| Lamp lenses           | PC (hard-coated)                 |
| Radome emblem         | PC with metallised indium layer  |
| Fasteners / clips     | PA, steel                        |
